name: Decrepit Ferry
summary: At the Decrepit Ferry, broken docks leave Fenris Isle cut off across Lordamere Lake. The Scourge killed the ferryman and wrecked the boats, and undead and Rot Hide gnolls now overrun the shore.

sections.title: A Lifeline Cut Short
sections.body: Before the Third War, daily traffic crossed Lordamere Lake from this dock. Local farmers brought fresh produce to the water and sold it to the wealthy lord of Fenris Isle and his household. For a modest fee, the ferryman carried trade goods, messengers, and visiting nobles between the mainland and the keep. That commerce ended when the Scourge swept through the kingdom. The ferryman was brutally killed, the boats were smashed, and the pier fell into decay.

sections.title: A Corrupted Shoreline
sections.body: The docks are dangerous for travelers along the lake shore. With the ferry out of service, Fenris Isle sits isolated across the water. Ghouls, skeletal warriors, and roving Rot Hide gnolls roam the ruins. The former crossing is now a dangerous stretch of Silverpine shoreline.

faq.q: What was the Decrepit Ferry used for originally?
aliases: why is there a ferry here
faq.answer: The ferry carried people and goods between mainland Silverpine and Fenris Isle. Farmers brought their harvest across Lordamere Lake to sell to the island's wealthy lord, and paid the ferryman a modest fee for each passage.

faq.q: What happened to the ferry and its ferryman?
faq.answer: When the Scourge swept through Lordaeron, the ferryman was murdered and the boats were smashed. The pier fell into decay, and the crossing ended.

faq.q: What monsters lurk around the ferry docks now?
faq.answer: Ghouls and skeletal warriors roam the shore, alongside Rot Hide gnolls that prowl the nearby banks.

faq.q: Can you still take a boat to Fenris Isle from here?
aliases: how to get to fenris isle
faq.answer: No. The boats were smashed and the pier fell into decay, leaving Fenris Isle cut off across the lake.

angles.text: As an Undead, you see Lordaeron's fall in these ruins. Scourge remnants and Rot Hide gnolls now threaten Forsaken operations in eastern Silverpine.
